description: Angular component for a time window selector in the Thingsboard UI, managing display, editing, and overlay panel interactions for time window configurations.

classes.name: TimewindowComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing a time window selection UI, including overlay panel interactions and display logic.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, updates style and display.

methods.name: toggleTimewindow
methods.description: Opens overlay panel for time window selection.

methods.name: updateTimewindowStyle
methods.description: Updates style based on current configuration.

methods.name: onHistoryOnlyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to 'historyOnly' property, updates model accordingly.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes value to component, initializes model, updates display.

methods.name: notifyChanged
methods.description: Emits change event and optionally saves default.

methods.name: displayValue
methods.description: Returns display string for current time window.

methods.name: updateDisplayValue
methods.description: Updates display string based on current model.

methods.name: isTimewindowDisabled
methods.description: Determines if the time window control should be disabled.

methods.name: createPanel
methods.description: Creates overlay panel for time window editing.
